# events.factor.EventFactor { #fmrimod.events.factor.EventFactor }

```python
EventFactor(name, onsets, values, durations=0, levels=None, contrasts=None)
```

Categorical event with discrete levels.

This represents events that take on discrete values (conditions,
categories, etc.) in an fMRI experiment.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                   | Description                                                      | Default    |
|-----------|------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| name      | str                    | Name of the event                                                | _required_ |
| onsets    | array - like           | Event onset times                                                | _required_ |
| values    | array - like           | Categorical values for each event                                | _required_ |
| durations | scalar or array - like | Event durations. If scalar, used for all events. Default is 0.   | `0`        |
| levels    | list                   | Explicit ordering of factor levels. If None, inferred from data. | `None`     |
| contrasts | dict                   | Contrast coding for levels                                       | `None`     |

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name     | Type           | Description                                |
|----------|----------------|--------------------------------------------|
| values   | pd.Categorical | Categorical representation of event values |
| levels   | list           | Ordered factor levels                      |
| n_levels | int            | Number of unique levels                    |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Simple categorical event
>>> event = EventFactor(
...     name='condition',
...     onsets=[1, 2, 3, 4],
...     values=['A', 'B', 'A', 'B']
... )
>>>
>>> # With explicit levels and durations
>>> event = EventFactor(
...     name='condition',
...     onsets=[1, 2, 3, 4],
...     values=['easy', 'hard', 'easy', 'medium'],
...     levels=['easy', 'medium', 'hard'],
...     durations=1.5
... )
```

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [design_matrix](#fmrimod.events.factor.EventFactor.design_matrix) | Generate design matrix columns for this event. |

### design_matrix { #fmrimod.events.factor.EventFactor.design_matrix }

```python
design_matrix(sampling_points)
```

Generate design matrix columns for this event.

Creates indicator columns for each level (dummy coding).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type   | Description                | Default    |
|-----------------|--------|----------------------------|------------|
| sampling_points | Array  | Time points to evaluate at | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                           |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | Array  | Design matrix columns, shape (n_timepoints, n_levels) |

### from_dataframe { #fmrimod.events.factor.EventFactor.from_dataframe }

```python
from_dataframe(
    df,
    name,
    onset_col='onset',
    value_col=None,
    duration_col='duration',
    **kwargs,
)
```

Create EventFactor from DataFrame.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type         | Description                                 | Default      |
|--------------|--------------|---------------------------------------------|--------------|
| df           | pd.DataFrame | DataFrame containing event data             | _required_   |
| name         | str          | Name for the event                          | _required_   |
| onset_col    | str          | Column name for onsets                      | `'onset'`    |
| value_col    | str          | Column name for values. If None, uses name. | `None`       |
| duration_col | str          | Column name for durations                   | `'duration'` |
| **kwargs     | object       | Additional arguments passed to EventFactor  | `{}`         |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type        | Description              |
|--------|-------------|--------------------------|
|        | EventFactor | New EventFactor instance |
